alerts.title: Significant weight gain and metabolic changes on DTG-based ART
alerts.message: Guidelines state weight gain should be discussed when starting ART and proactive diet and exercise advice given to patients on or switching ART. Patient has gained 17 kg (65 to 82 kg) and BMI rose from 25.6 to 32.4 kg/m² over 18 months on TLD, with waist 96 cm, acanthosis nigricans, BP 138/88, fasting glucose 118 mg/dL, HbA1c 6.1%, and dyslipidaemia (LDL 148, HDL 38, TG 212). Weight gain is plausibly associated with DTG, which is known to be associated with weight gain, but she has obesity risk factors including family history of T2DM, and the switch from EFV may also have contributed; drug attribution is uncertain. Her CD4 and viral suppression are good.

evidence.recommended_action: Counsel on diet and exercise for weight management now. Screen and monitor glucose and lipids, and assess cardiovascular risk. Consider metabolic management and review of the ART regimen with a specialist if weight gain and metabolic changes persist.
